drafts.instagram:
تخفيضات Resident Evil على Steam في الخليج حتى 3 نوفمبر.

خفّضت شركة كابكوم (Capcom) سعر Resident Evil 4 على متجر Steam بنسبة 75%، فأصبح سعرها 34.98 درهمًا في الإمارات بدلًا من 139.92، و32.80 ريالًا في السعودية بدلًا من 131.22.

ويشمل العرض Resident Evil Village بالسعر نفسه، وResident Evil 2 بخصم 80% (27.98 درهمًا و26.24 ريالًا)، وResident Evil Requiem بخصم 30% (176.36 درهمًا و165.20 ريالًا)، إلى جانب Monster Hunter Wilds بخصم 25% وPRAGMATA بخصم 20%.

وتدعم هذه الألعاب اللغة العربية على Steam، وينتهي العرض يوم 3 نوفمبر.

#ألعاب #أخبار_الألعاب #ResidentEvil #Steam

notes: Brief: family 7 (release/deals) with the WHERE AND HOW MUCH beat as price lines (design-pass frame not rolled out yet). Template clipcard (price kind, more than three facts, so not split). Hook: Leon's face, then Ashley (RE4 PV3 72.5 s) under «تخفيض Resident Evil 4 / بنسبة 75% في الخليج» (number + the series people know). Beats: AED price on Luis (79.0 s, line about RE4 over RE4); SAR on Ashley close-up (20.75 s) and Leon (117.5 s); one card for the end date on RE4 footage dimmed; Requiem 30% over Requiem's own Leon, Leon at the monitor and Grace (Requiem launch PV 2.2, 9.5, 11.5 s); close on Leon (51.75 s) and Krauser (53.5 s) under the Arabic-support line, a picture to the end. About 20.9 s. Sensitive: none; RE is mature: no blood or gore picked (34.5, 48, 103.5 s of PV3 skipped).

Sound: our bed (neon_e, rotation), reason: all three Capcom trailers fetched are voiced end to end (speechcheck --stretch: RE4 launch PV 52 and 60 s, 12 to 16 words in 21 s; RE4 PV3 0 s, 24 words; 106 s stretch heard 'I'm gonna get you all safe' and more under the lines; Requiem launch PV 4 s, 53 words), and a four-line price Reel has no pauses to place lines in. Director: signed off for a price story. Preview says 'our bed' first.
Sources decode clean (re4-pv3, re9-launch). The RE4 launch PV was dropped: burnt-in English subtitles under most faces.

Arabic: grammar stage: two required edits (بدل to بدلًا من, glossary), applied; nothing else. DeepL back-check: meaning holds on headline, lines, card and caption. Forward pass on the caption and three phrasings of the end date ('The offer ends', 'The sale ends', 'Discount runs until'): DeepL gives ينتهي العرض twice and يستمر العرض حتى once; ours is ينتهي العرض, kept.
Runs 1 and 2 failed on the runner: the Requiem line ran out of the safe zone at 70 px (now 56), then the smear flag caught the cut to Requiem's title card (shot ends 3.1 s; block_ok on the cut).

v1 (runner): the Requiem title card flashed at 13.5 s, the hook showed Leon's and Ashley's eyes under the headline band, the RE4 close on Leon was nearly black. v2: hook on Ashley still showed only her mouth under the band; Requiem section had a photo board and the back of Grace's head. v3 (director round 2): hook on Luis (face below the band), Ashley for the AED line, Ashley, Ada and Leon for SAR, Grace from 11.4 s, close on Leon and Krauser; closing line shortened to «وتدعم هذه الألعاب / العربية على Steam» for reading time (meaning unchanged: Arabic support).

v3: the 100 px headline band covered Luis's face, leaving his jacket under the headline; Grace still read as hair. v4: hook opens on Ada (face mid-frame, below the band), then Leon and Ashley; Luis carries the AED line (face fully clear there). Lesson: under the grid-tile headline (band to about a third of the frame), a close-up whose eyes sit in the top third loses them; hook shots need the face mid-to-low.

Director QA v4 (round 2 of 2, passed with a note): 0.0 Ada face under the headline PASS (3:4 tile reads at grid size); Leon, Ashley under the headline PASS; Luis with the AED price PASS; Ashley close-up and Ada with the SAR line PASS; end-date card on dimmed RE4 footage PASS; Requiem: Leon PASS, Leon at the monitor with the photo board (0.25 s) and Grace from behind (0.75 s) NOTE, weak but on subject; Leon PASS; close Leon then Krauser PASS (no gore: Krauser's knife glint only). Reel: changes every 1 to 3 s; last two seconds a picture; our bed with its reason. Final decode clean, 21.5 s with the end card.
gate 12:14Z: Steam appdetails cc=ae and cc=sa unchanged (RE4 34.98 AED / 32.80 SR, Requiem 176.36 AED / 165.20 SR); store page 'Offer ends 3 November'.
